claims.text: The hotel is in historic Wan Chai on Hong Kong Island.

findings.quote: The St. Regis Hong Kong is located in the heart of historic Wan Chai on Hong Kong Island

claims.text: The hotel is within easy walking distance of the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre and Victoria Harbour.

findings.quote: within easy walking distance of the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre, as well as Victoria Harbour

claims.text: The interiors reflect the vision of interior designer André Fu, conceived as a curated mansion in the heart of Wan Chai.

findings.quote: Reflecting the unique vision of St. Regis through the eyes of interior designer André Fu, our luxury hotel in Hong Kong is a curated mansion in the heart of Wan Chai district

claims.text: Butlers greet guests curbside and take them straight to their room for in-room check-in.

findings.quote: your dedicated butlers will greet you curbside and welcome you into the House of Astor, whisking you into the hotel straight to your room for in-room check in.

claims.text: L'Envol is a French restaurant led by Chef Olivier Elzer.

findings.quote: Led by Chef Olivier Elzer, this two-MICHELIN-starred French restaurant introduces innovative French cuisine to Wan Chai district on Hong Kong Island.

claims.text: L'Envol serves over 40 cheeses on a three-tiered trolley.

findings.quote: over 40 decadent cheeses served on a 3-tiered trolley

claims.text: Rùn is a Cantonese restaurant led by chef Hung Chi-Kwong.

findings.quote: The mastery of chef Hung Chi-Kwong is evident at this two-MICHELIN-starred Chinese restaurant in Hong Kong serving classic Cantonese.

claims.text: At Rùn, a tea master brews a welcome tea and a digestif tea tailored to each guest's preference.

findings.quote: Expect also a soothing welcome tea and a digestif tea brewed by our tea master tailored to each guest's preference.

claims.text: The St. Regis Bar serves signature cocktails inspired by New York's subway and Hong Kong's tramline.

findings.quote: our bar in Hong Kong serves signature cocktails inspired by New York's subway and Hong Kong's tramline.

claims.text: The Verandah Pool is a heated outdoor swimming pool.

findings.quote: ### The Verandah Pool
take a swim at our heated outdoor swimming pool

claims.text: The spa uses products from 001 Skincare London and 3LAB.

findings.quote: bespoke treatments using result-driven products from luxury skincare brands – 001 Skincare London and 3LAB

claims.text: The Presidential Suite has floor-to-ceiling windows with panoramic city and harbour views.

findings.quote: Floor-to-ceiling windows look out to panoramic city and harbour views

claims.text: The hotel performs a champagne sabrage ceremony every day to mark the transition from day to evening.

findings.quote: The St. Regis Hong Kong performs the sabrage ceremony at 5:30 pm every day to celebrate the transition from day to evening.

claims.text: The open-air Astor Terrace has a marble water feature leading to a 2.5-metre-high moon gate, a traditional element of Chinese gardens.

findings.quote: Cool and verdant, the adjacent Astor Terrace is a peaceful, inviting, open-air haven
marble water feature which leads to a 2.5-metre high moon gate, a traditional element in Chinese gardens.

claims.text: Bedrooms have a curved, winged headboard capped by white lacquer panels reminiscent of traditional Wan Chai shop shutters.

findings.quote: a gently curved, winged headboard capped by white coloured lacquer panels reminiscent of traditional Wan Chai shop shutters

claims.text: At Afternoon Tea, guests choose their own savouries and sweets from a dim sum-inspired trolley.

findings.quote: allows guests to select their choice of savouries and sweets based on their preferences from a dim sum-inspired trolley.

claims.text: The St. Regis Bar's Canto Mary, its take on the Bloody Mary, uses chen pi (dried tangerine peel), Kowloon soy sauce and Chinese five-spice.

findings.quote: Sample our own rendition of signature Bloody Mary, named Canto Mary
Local ingredients include "chen pi" (dried tangerine peel), Kowloon soy sauce and Chinese five-spice mix

claims.text: The hotel does not provide an airport shuttle service; Hong Kong International Airport is approximately 39.3 km away.

findings.quote: This hotel does not provide shuttle service.
HKG is located approximately 39.3 KM from the hotel.

claims.text: Pets are not allowed at the hotel.

findings.quote: No, pets are not allowed at The St. Regis Hong Kong.

claims.text: WhataHotel notes ultra-luxury pricing and a formal atmosphere that may not suit all travelers.
